issues.issue: This all-funds budget line includes business-type interest of 4,289 (p6; governmental 19,763 on p4), but it is all tagged governmental. The amount is right and the line is marked review. The fund type is mixed.

The budget schedule prints Other 15,022, while the governmental funds statement (p4) and statement of activities (p2) print 15,021. This is a 1-dollar rounding difference in the report itself; it is not recorded in report_discrepancies. The notes also say interest differs by 1, but it does not (19,763 + 4,289 = 24,052).
